description: For 160 years, General Mills, Inc. has been making food the world loves, and it is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of branded consumer foods with more than 100 brands in 100 countries across six continents. In addition to its consolidated operations, it has 50 percent interests in two strategic joint ventures that manufacture and market food products sold in approximately 120 countries worldwide. It manages and reviews the financial results of its business under four operating segments, North America Retail, International, North America Pet and North America Foodservice, and offers a variety of human and pet food products that provide great taste, nutrition, convenience and value for consumers around the world, focused on large global categories such as snacks, ready-to-eat cereal and pet food.
